# Acme Docs

> Start here to install and run Acme.

Source: https://acme.shiru.sh/ · Markdown: https://acme.shiru.sh/index.md

Acme turns a config file into a running service. Read the [setup guide](/guides/setup/) first.

# FAQ

## Does Acme run offline?

Yes. See [setup](/guides/setup/#install).

# Setup

> Install Acme and start it.

Source: https://acme.shiru.sh/guides/setup/ · Markdown: https://acme.shiru.sh/guides/setup/index.md

## Install

Install the CLI, then go back to the [overview](/).

> **Note**
>
> Acme needs Node 24 or later.
